decisions.reason: This door lever handle family remains deeply embedded in the firm's core architectural hardware and specification capabilities, so accumulated market feedback can be absorbed and used for incremental refinement rather than withdrawal.
The mitred door lever handle family is somewhat more design-niche, but it still draws on the firm's existing metalworking, finishing and architect-facing know-how, which supports continued retention.

The multifunctional door lever handle fits the firm's strong knowledge base in ergonomic, compliant and system-oriented hardware, giving management good scope to learn from use cases and improve it commercially.
The door and window handle collection has the strongest validation through award recognition and family-level fit with the firm's coordinated offer, making a near-term withdrawal highly unlikely.

The light patinated bronze finish is fully within the firm's in-house finishing competence and complements existing ranges, though finishes remain more style- and demand-sensitive than core hardware platforms.
